description: Adds a translated ship and weapon pack featuring various vessels from frigates to supercapitals. Includes weapons ranging from underpowered to good damage dealers and cool hullmods. Recent updates fixed localization issues, added phase fields to specific hulls, and introduced new Colossus-class battleships with built-in weapons.

discordPostHtml:
Chinasector mod translated into english. Features all kinds of boats, from frigates to supercapitals.
Weapons range from rather underpowered to good damage dealers.
Dunno what else to say here. Hullmods are kinda cool.

Older version was posted with barebones translation back in 2025, which also featured a crash associated with one of the LPCs. Works fine now.

changelog.1.73-HF3:
Fixed several localization issues, names of a few variants got scrambled into gibberish:
 contaminate-tds_N.variant
indignation-tds_N.variant
owl-tds_N.variant
 I've also somewhat rewritten descriptions and codex entries and such, should be far more comprehensive now.
There were also some chunks of garbled text in there too, gone as well now, hopefully (I apologize in advance for my poor eyesight)
changelog.1.73-HF1:
Some hulls which were supposed to be phase ships didn't have a phasefield hullmod on them, which could cause a crash while mousing over\installing hullmods which affect phasing.
 These now have the required hullmod:
 Amberelder
Irenaeus Lp
Windsspawn
Hippolytus Lp
Ithaqua
Epiphanius Lp
Deathwalker
Deathwalker Xiv
Gnostic Lp
 Should be safe compatible!
changelog.1.73:
Four Colossus Colossus are installed.
The Colossus is a special battleship with slightly lower values than ordinary battleships but longer long plates
The core feature is that all the main weapons are built-in, so there is relatively little assembly space
 Gabriel-class low-tech heavy shield armor with built-in 2X flagship live-fire kinetic energy gun
The Solotor-class high-tech medium shield armor can also be equipped with 6X guided energy torpedoes
Jinyue Low-Tech Heavy Armor Shieldless with Built-in 4X Heavy Pulse Laser
Stria Zhongke 1.4 Shield Effect China-A 10-deck aircraft carrier
 Others include fine-tuning of some weapon values, rebalancing of carrier-based aircraft, and adjustment and mapping of ship weapon firing ranges
